<.component component_name="chelekom-table" site="Global" id="tbl-shipment-status" variant="base_stripped" rounded="large" padding="medium" header_border="extra_small">
  <:header>Order</:header>
  <:header>Destination</:header>
  <:header>Carrier</:header>
  <:header>Status</:header>
  <:header>Estimated arrival</:header>
  <.component component_name="chelekom-tr" site="Global">
    <.component component_name="chelekom-td" site="Global" class="font-medium">#10482</.component>
    <.component component_name="chelekom-td" site="Global">Bristol, UK</.component>
    <.component component_name="chelekom-td" site="Global">Royal Mail</.component>
    <.component component_name="chelekom-td" site="Global">
      <.component component_name="chelekom-badge" site="Global" color="info" rounded="full" icon="hero-truck">Out for delivery</.component>
    </.component>
    <.component component_name="chelekom-td" site="Global">Today, before 18:00</.component>
  </.component>
  <.component component_name="chelekom-tr" site="Global">
    <.component component_name="chelekom-td" site="Global" class="font-medium">#10483</.component>
    <.component component_name="chelekom-td" site="Global">Rotterdam, NL</.component>
    <.component component_name="chelekom-td" site="Global">DHL Express</.component>
    <.component component_name="chelekom-td" site="Global">
      <.component component_name="chelekom-badge" site="Global" color="warning" rounded="full" icon="hero-clock">Held at customs</.component>
    </.component>
    <.component component_name="chelekom-td" site="Global">Thursday</.component>
  </.component>
  <.component component_name="chelekom-tr" site="Global">
    <.component component_name="chelekom-td" site="Global" class="font-medium">#10484</.component>
    <.component component_name="chelekom-td" site="Global">Tabriz, IR</.component>
    <.component component_name="chelekom-td" site="Global">Post Company</.component>
    <.component component_name="chelekom-td" site="Global">
      <.component component_name="chelekom-badge" site="Global" color="success" rounded="full" icon="hero-check">Delivered</.component>
    </.component>
    <.component component_name="chelekom-td" site="Global">Signed for on Monday</.component>
  </.component>
</.component>
